_doc: check_empty_scope.py: which gates may report success over a repo with no content.
legitimate = it SHOULD pass on nothing, and the reason says why.
known_blind = a real defect awaiting a guard. SHRINK-ONLY: never add to this list;
a gate that gains a guard is deleted from it, and the sweep fails if a listed gate
starts failing (a stale excuse is permission nobody needs).

legitimate.check_estate_corpus.py: its subject is the CONSUMER ESTATE, not the tree it is invoked in: it copies real subtrees out of other repos into a temp directory and never reads this repo at all, so a tree with no content cannot blind it. Not a silence -- every entry that could not be measured is named and counted in the summary, and an estate that is not on this machine reads 0/N verified, not N/N
legitimate.check_display_seam.py: requires --policy and says so: it has no opinion about a consumer's display, and a default policy would be a wrong opinion rather than a convenient one. The sweep cannot supply a policy, so the gate is excused here rather than counted as having looked. Before 2026-10-03 the sweep scored its argparse usage error as a healthy refusal, so the gate had never run and nothing said so
legitimate.check_tests_registered.py: requires --buildsystem, and the answer genuinely differs per build system — there is no default that is right rather than merely convenient. Same history: scored as a healthy refusal while never having run
legitimate.check_baseline_ratchet.py: requires --baseline and says so: the sweep cannot supply one that is right rather than merely convenient, so the gate is excused here rather than counted as having looked. Until 2026-10-05 it crashed in the skeleton on `import killtree` (lib/ is mirrored empty) and the sweep scored the crash as a refusal, so this excuse was never needed and its absence never noticed
